entities.summary: Alejandro Diz is a former volleyball player from Argentina who represented his native country in two Summer Olympics. After having finished in sixth place at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles, he was a member of the men's national team four years later in the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul, winning the bronze medal.
